question: Which fixed early and late AT1 panel constituents produce the original ES1 RNA detection contrasts?
decision: Clarify measured panel attribution before interpreting an apparent maturation difference; retain original unfavorable or unsupported contrasts.
strongest_rival: Joint RNA sampling, sparse detection and reference selection can change panel measurements without altered maturation or future AT1 contribution.
discriminator: All seven original panel genes, both original technical draws and the same full joint sampling universe; reconstruct original early/late module and support results.
exposure_record: Original ES1 module outcomes are exposed. Exact panel membership, all five source feature maps and full 1503-gene order reviewed before new per-gene draws. Both seeds are technical sensitivity, not new independent evidence.
biological_unit: Ten original pooled multiome libraries and original external source-identified animals, with cells nested within units.
nesting_and_overlap: Each multiome condition is one pooled library. Two seeds reuse cells. External animals were previously analyzed, with no neonatal arm; none of these is independent confirmation.
population_and_selection: All original ES1 units and external author-labelled alveolar cells. Same barcode order, full RNA depth at least 2000, airway sum no greater than alveolar sum; identical within-unit seed restart and gate labels.
contrast: Two-marker Cldn4/Krt8 detected minus Sftpc-detected non-two-marker reference, within each unit and seed; descriptive only.
endpoint: Seven member detected counts/fractions and panel-normalized constituent contributions; early three-gene and late four-gene module detection differences.
methods: Hash-bound original read_10x, joint_sample and external read logic with a new run-only callback. Full sorted 1503-gene universe and residual category, budget 2000 and seeds 17/29. Save cell identities, filter primitives, sampled panel/gate counts and support. Require original module/support/contrast parity within 1e-10.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep every original failed-support row. Interpretation requires both groups at least 30 cells and original coverage at least 0.8. Missing features, unit/order/source conflict or parity failure stops; no seed or gate tuning.
multiplicity: Every early/late member, both seeds and every original unit retained without ranking, new targets or inferential tests.
precision_basis: Original support thresholds describe measurement eligibility, not power. Pooled wells and technical seeds cannot estimate independent biological variance.
interpretation_limit: Panel detection and attribution do not identify maturation, future AT1 contribution, lineage or reversibility. Reused full AT1/ADI summaries remain context; no replacement program or factorial comparison.
stop_rule: Stop on source/hash/feature/order/identity/raw-domain or original support/score conflict; preserve failed attempts without tuning.
amendment_reason: New fixed constituent attribution of the same ES1 early/late panels; original scripts and outputs immutable. Execute on task-owned X: checkout with identical relative inputs and frozen commit.
